LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticCarapaceBond.label: symbiotic carapace bond
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticCarapaceBond.descripti: Symbiotic armor is bonded to the wearer. Its regenerative systems increase hunger and repair ordinary injuries while the wearer is not hungry.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticMetabolicStrain.label: symbiotic metabolic strain
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticMetabolicStrain.descri: Repeated symbiotic regeneration overtaxes the wearer's metabolism. Severe strain lowers immunity and increases rest loss; extreme strain can cause abnormal tissue growth and can be treated by a doctor.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilNeuralFatigue.label: phaseveil neural fatigue
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilNeuralFatigue.descript: Repeated phase shifting strains the nervous system. It recovers slowly, and faster while resting. At severe levels it impairs consciousness, movement, and manipulation; at dangerous levels Phaseveil cannot be activated.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilActive.label: phaseveil active
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilActive.description: The wearer is phase-shifted and difficult to perceive.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilCooldown.label: phaseveil cooldown
